questions.question: If 4 December 1987 is a Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 12 December 2009?
questions.solution:
If 4 December 1987 is a Friday. Then, **12 December 1987 is (Friday + 8) = Saturday**

Logic: We know a normal year advances the start of the next year by 1 day and a leap year advances the start of the year by 2 days.

Number of odd days between 12 December 1987 and 12 December 2009:

→ (2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1) = **28 = Four weeks**

So, 12 December 2009 will be (Saturday + 28) = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Saturday"**.

questions.question: If 15 July 2010 is a Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 5 June 2022?
questions.solution:
Given: **15 July 2010** was Thursday.

Now,

2010 to 2022 = 12 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap years and 9 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 9 = 15.

15 odd days → 15/7 = 2 weeks and 1 odd day.

then, 15 July 2022 will be Thursday + 1 = Friday.

Now, the number of days between 5 June 2022 to 15 July 2022

= (25) June + 15 (July) = 40 days.

= 40 days → 40/7 = 5 weeks and 5 odd days.

So, **5 June 2022** will be Friday - 5 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Two clocks were synchronised at 11 a.m. on a Sunday. Thereafter, every day they were, respectively, found to gain and lose one minute per day. What time, expressed in hours and minutes, will the second clock show when the first clock shows 10 p.m. on the next Friday?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two clocks were synchronised at 11 a.m. on a Sunday.

Every day they were, respectively, found to gain and lose one minute per day.

**Calculation:**

From Sunday 11 a.m to Friday 10 p.m total time = 131 hours

According to the question,

In the case of 1st clock

To go 24(1)/({60)} or (1441/60) hours it is taking 24 hours

So, to go 131 hours it is taking (24 × 131)/(1441/60)

In the case of 2nd clock

In 24 hours it is going (24 - (1)/({60)}) hours or (1439/60) hours

So,

In (24 × 131)/(1441/60) hours it is going [1439/60 × (24 × 131)/(1441/60)]/24

⇒ 1439/11

⇒ 130(9)/({11)}hours

So, from Sunday 11 am + 130(9)/({11)}hours = Friday 9(9)/({11)} p.m or 9 hours 49(1)/({11)} minutes p.m.

**∴ Required answer is 9 hours 49(1)/({11)} minutes p.m.**

questions.question: If 11th June 1987 is Thursday. then what will be the day of the week on 4th Dec 1989?
questions.solution:
Given: **11th June 1987 was Thursday.**

Now,

1987 to 1989 = 2 Years (1 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year).

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 1 Ordinary Year has 1 odd day.

Total odd days = 2 + 1 = 3.

then, 11th June 1989 will be Thursday + 3 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 11th June 1989 to 4th Dec 1989

= 19(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 30(September) + 31(October) + 30(November) + 4(December) = 176 days.

= 176 days → 176/7 = 25 week and 1 odd day.

So, **4th Dec 1989** will be Sunday + 1 = Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
